integrity: Exact finite checks are supplementary to the analytic proof. Standalone verification uses only standard Python and finite checks are not a certification of all n.
scientific_limitations: Uniform insertion permutations and two deterministic extreme key ranks only. Does not cover nonuniform insertion laws, arbitrary key pairs, or higher-order negative association. Historical implicit derivations may exist.
title: Strict negative dependence of the two extreme-key depths in random binary search trees
